IHS Holland Scholarship 2023 is an initiative of the Institute for Housing and Urban Development Studies (IHS), Erasmus University Rotterdam for students who want to pursue their bachelor's or master's degree in the Netherlands. The students selected for the scholarship will receive € 5,000 every year based on academic excellence.
To be eligible for this scholarship, an applicant must:
be a non-EEA (European Economic Area) national
have applied for a full-time bachelor's or master's at Erasmus University Rotterdam
meet the specific requirements of the institution of choice
not hold a diploma from an education facility in the Netherlands
The students selected for the scholarship will receive € 5,000 every year based on academic excellence.
Proof of excellence during Bachelor's (certified copy of bachelor's degree including grade list)
Description of financial position including a bank statement
*Note - If the applicants have not completed their bachelor's yet, the average grade of the current year until the date of application will be considered.
